name: deep_miner_spots
summary: Where a deep miner would mine what: the profile at a point, and with ores the nearest spots whose profile holds them all. Follows the world's own region maps. Read only.

help.text: The game gives a deep miner the first deep-mining profile whose region condition holds where it is built; this asks the same profiles the same way. Always returns at {position, regions, profile_id (null: a miner there mines nothing)} and profiles [{id, reagents [{reagent, grams}] per dirty ore, quantity [min, max) ores per drop, time_s [min, max) per drop at 200 RPM, regions}] in the order the miner tries them.
help.keys: at {position, regions, profile_id}, profiles [{id, reagents, quantity, time_s, regions}], search {ores, profiles, radius_m, step_m, min_separation_m, ...}, spots [{at, distance_m, bearing_deg, compass, profile_id, regions, terrain}], beacons [{at, label}].

search.text: With ores (reagent names as profiles list them; Hydrocarbon is coal), it searches a disc around at, nearest first, on a grid no finer than the region map (under 250000 samples, 8 s budget). Returns search {ores, profiles, radius_m, step_m, min_separation_m, samples, matched, searched_radius_m, truncated}, spots [{at (the 2 m cell centre at the ground), distance_m, bearing_deg (0 = +z north, 90 = +x east), compass, profile_id, regions, terrain}] and beacons in the shape highlight takes for points.

terrain.summary: The terrain check at each spot.
terrain.text: terrain {ground_y, cell_volume_l, terrain_ok, note} is read from the terrain's own density anywhere in the world. terrain_ok holds when the miner's own rule passes at the spot (world volume in its cell at most 6000 L, which needs terrain in the cell). The placement cursor's other checks (structures in the way, the whole footprint) are not run.

at.description: The point to report and the search centre; default the player's position (see positions).

ores.description: Reagents a spot's profile must all hold (["Cobalt"]); without it, the point and profiles only.

min_separation_m.description: Least distance between two spots; default 100 (0: neighbouring samples).

step_m.description: Sample spacing, never finer than the region map; default the finest within the budget.
